notes.use: A big hall with a dirt floor and rugs laid over it; the twelve-arm nest lantern; piles of sticks and worms; the light switch by the east door.
notes.wear: Damp earth, feathers, straw, droppings, scratched plaster, rugs stained and tidy in turns.
notes.wrong: The birds on the lantern are never twelve when counted; the dirt is warm; the switch is on a different wall each time.
